title: Enterprise Connectivity: separate statutory tax handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: When the corresponding accounting action is due, this entry governs separate statutory tax. The accountant posts the separate network tax debit against the exact net invoice. The positive tax receivable completes its tax component immediately; the tax receipt confirms posting.

## Handling condition
Before completing the tax component of an assisted transfer bill, issue its net-only invoice.

## Invocation
tax_network_645ca35d is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter customer_id
Separate statutory tax uses `customer_id`: Id class — Customer profile identifier copied from find_customers.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Separate statutory tax uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Separate statutory tax uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Authoritative source evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Separate statutory tax uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact export or net invoice identifier copied from find_network_events or the preceding invoice receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id
Separate statutory tax uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Pricing review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter request_id
Separate statutory tax uses `request_id`: Id class — Customer acceptance identifier copied from the actual preceding authorization receipt.

## Parameter amount
Separate statutory tax uses `amount`: Fixed-format class — Positive receivable component in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number with two-decimal precision, supplied after final half-up rounding and stored at two decimals.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary with event_id (string business-event identifier) and amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); this receipt confirms completion.
